SELECT
  home_store
  , COUNT(DISTINCT __first_buyer_count) AS first_buyer_count
  , SUM(__first_order_sales_cents) AS first_order_sales_cents
  , SUM(__first_order_count) AS first_order_count
  , SUM(__repeat_order_count) AS repeat_order_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    home_store_id AS home_store
    , case when order_rank = 1 then member_id end AS __first_buyer_count
    , case when order_rank = 1 then net_sales_cents else 0 end AS __first_order_sales_cents
    , case when order_rank = 1 then 1 else 0 end AS __first_order_count
    , case when order_rank >= 2 then 1 else 0 end AS __repeat_order_count
  FROM "data"."main"."valid_orders_sequenced" order_history_semantic_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_8
GROUP BY
  home_store
